a warm golden-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, waist-length braids teal hair — wearing nothing but hand-painted body art: Celtic knotwork, endless interlaced bands and spiral triquetra knots painted by brush in deep green and gold body paint over her bust zone shaped like a strapless sweetheart bra, two rounded cups with a softly dipped heart-shaped upper edge covering each breast fully and a band under the bust, her shoulders and collarbones plain bare skin, one continuous strand of interlaced Celtic knotwork from the same artwork running down the cleavage between the cups, tying the two cups together, brushed directly on her skin, clean edges all around, and her hip zone shaped like fitted boyshorts covering her pelvic area and the tops of her thighs with clean edges along the waistline and the leg bands, slightly irregular hand-painted edges, every other part of her body, her arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, plain bare real skin. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
